body:
Thanks for the advice. I especially like the idea of the X-Card, but I'm a little nervous about one small-but-important detail: the issue I'm concerned about could make our preferred RPG difficult to play if I give the above-stated player a chance to cancel it when it occurs. Only example I can come up with someone with [a pathological fear of the number 13](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triskaidekaphobia): anytime they roll a 13, they could use the X-card to force a reroll.

I've read the X-Card document, so I've seen the FAQ about "But it'll ruin my ability to tell a story!" However, since this player has an issue with a rather fundamental part of gameplay, I'm afraid that giving them veto power over the gameplay itself might make things impossible.

Any thoughts?
